proof:
Source. Parent proof step 0. Mathlib's GNS inequality (Mathlib/Analysis/FunctionalSpaces/SobolevInequality.lean, `lintegral_pow_le_pow_lintegral_fderiv`) replaces Simon's citation of [GT01] in the Sobolev step of Ch. 3, 4.3 (chapter-03.txt lines 689–712). Its conclusion has exactly the shape of hypothesis (H). The parent supplies (H) from that Mathlib theorem. This child performs the parent's 'routine bookkeeping between lintegral and the real integral' and the choice c := c₀ + 1 > 0. It uses no import beyond the contract's.

Fix P, p > 0, C ≥ 0 and (H). Write L := L^P.

1. Constant. Put c := C^{1/p} + 1, where C^{1/p} is the real power of the real number C ≥ 0. Then c ≥ 1 > 0. It depends only on C and p. Now fix a C¹ function w : R^P → R with compact support, and set K := tsupport w, a compact set.

2. The derivative term. w is C¹, so w and Dw are continuous. Dw vanishes outside K: w ≡ 0 on the open set R^P \ K, so Dw = 0 there (HasCompactSupport.fderiv). Thus Dw is continuous with compact support, hence L-integrable. In particular A := ∫⁻ ‖Dw‖ₑ dL < ∞, and ∫ |Dw| dL = A.toReal (integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm; Dw is a.e. strongly measurable because it is continuous).

3. The function term. Since p > 0, t ↦ t^p is continuous on [0, ∞). So x ↦ |w(x)|^p is continuous and nonnegative, hence a.e. strongly measurable. Therefore ∫ |w|^p dL = (∫⁻ ofReal(|w|^p) dL).toReal (integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae). For every x, ofReal(|w(x)|^p) = ofReal(|w(x)|)^p = ‖w(x)‖ₑ^p, by ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (|w(x)| ≥ 0, p ≥ 0) and ‖w(x)‖ₑ = ofReal ‖w(x)‖ = ofReal |w(x)|. Hence ∫ |w|^p dL = (∫⁻ ‖w‖ₑ^p dL).toReal.

4. Passing to real numbers. The right side C · A^p of (H) for w is finite: C is a finite constant, and A^p < ∞ because A < ∞ and p ≥ 0. ENNReal.toReal is monotone when the larger value is finite (ENNReal.toReal_mono). So (H) gives (∫⁻ ‖w‖ₑ^p dL).toReal ≤ (C · A^p).toReal = C · (A.toReal)^p (ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_rpow, ENNReal.coe_toReal). By steps 2 and 3, ∫ |w|^p dL ≤ C (∫ |Dw| dL)^p.

5. Taking the 1/p power. Put I := ∫ |Dw| dL ≥ 0. Both sides of step 4 are ≥ 0, and t ↦ t^{1/p} is monotone on [0, ∞) since 1/p > 0. Hence (∫ |w|^p dL)^{1/p} ≤ (C I^p)^{1/p} = C^{1/p} (I^p)^{1/p} = C^{1/p} I. Here Real.mul_rpow applies to C ≥ 0 and I^p ≥ 0, and Real.rpow_rpow_inv applies to I ≥ 0 and p ≠ 0. Since I ≥ 0, C^{1/p} I ≤ (C^{1/p} + 1) I = c I. This is (∫ |w|^p dL)^{1/p} ≤ c ∫ |Dw| dL. ∎
key_steps: For C¹ compactly supported w, Dw is continuous with compact support: ∫⁻‖Dw‖ₑ < ∞ and ∫|Dw| = (∫⁻‖Dw‖ₑ).toReal.
Take toReal of (H), whose right side is finite: ∫|w|^p ≤ C(∫|Dw|)^p.
